title: When Skills Tell Agents Not to Ask: A Large-Scale Study of Oversight Directives in Agent Skills
abstract: arXiv:2610.37734v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent skills, reusable instruction packages centred on a SKILL.md file, extend AI agents on demand, and a single line in a widely copied skill reaches every agent that loads it. Some lines are oversight-loosening directives: they tell the agent to proceed without approval, to bypass checks with --no-verify, or to keep working without checking in. Although such directives can remove a checkpoint from every agent that loads them, no prior work has examined them. We present the first large-scale study of oversight-loosening directives, analyzing 1.53 million English skills from GitSkills. We split skills into units (sentences, bullets, table cells, and code lines), develop a codebook that labels oversight directives by polarity, mechanism, and scope, label 2,097 units by hand, and train a detector to scale the analysis. translated_title: 当技能告诉智能体不要询问：智能体技能中监督指令的大规模研究
translated_abstract: 智能体技能是以SKILL.md文件为核心的可复用指令包，能够按需扩展AI智能体的能力，而一个被广泛复制的技能中的一行指令，会传递到加载该技能的每一个智能体。其中有些指令行属于放松监督的指令：它们告诉智能体无需获得批准即可继续执行、使用--no-verify绕过检查，或者不进行确认而持续工作。尽管这类指令能够从所有加载它们的智能体中移除一个检查点，但此前尚无研究对其进行考察。我们首次对放松监督的指令开展了大规模研究，分析了来自GitSkills的153万个英文技能。我们将技能拆分为单元（句子、列表项、表格单元格和代码行），编制了一套按极性、机制和范围对监督指令进行标注的编码手册，手工标注了2,097个单元，并训练了一个检测器以扩大分析规模。我们的结果显示，大约每十七个技能中就有一个（约88,000个技能）包含放松监督的指令。这些指令……
tldr: 该论文首次大规模研究了智能体技能（SKILL.md）中的放松监督指令，通过对153万个技能的编码与检测分析，发现约每十七个技能中就有一个（约88,000个）包含指示智能体跳过审批、绕过检查或无需确认的指令，揭示了技能生态中被忽视的监督风险。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first large-scale study of oversight-loosening directives in agent skills, analyzing 1.53 million skills and finding that about one in seventeen skills (~88,000) contains directives telling agents to proceed without approval, bypass checks, or keep working without checking in, revealing overlooked oversight risks in the skill ecosystem.
